title: Tier 2 frame props v1 (wire form)
description: A sandboxed custom app. bundle.upload is an upload of kind app bound to this message, whose stored SHA-256 and size equal bundle.sha256 and bundle.size (semantic check). data is any JSON, <= 32768 bytes canonical (semantic check), passed to the frame in init. The CLI authoring form uses bundle.file instead; the CLI uploads the file and rewrites it to this form, and the server rejects bundle.file.
